title: Low-Glycemic Moroccan Lamb Mrouzia
description: A kid-friendly, low-glycemic Moroccan dish featuring lamb, spices, and clear honey, made with a mother sauce base.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until it's softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin, cinnamon, and turmeric to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring it to a boil.
Return the lamb to the pot and cover it with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the oven and bake for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the Greek yogurt.
Serve the lamb with the sauce spooned over the top and a drizzle of clear honey.
